name: Massachusetts

context: MA 340: Cover crop reduces sheet, rill, and wind erosion.
MA 609: Surface roughening is for wind erosion on soils with high wind erosion potential where a planned system is not yet in place.
cover_rules: MA 340: Adjust seed to a minimum of 85% or PLS (pure live seed); the Cover Crop Seed Rate Calculator sets mix rates.
MA 340: Increased seeding rates (1.5 to 2 times normal) can improve the cover crop.
residue: MA 329: Keep a minimum of 60 percent residue cover on the soil surface throughout the year.
MA 329: The crop interval STIR value shall be no greater than 20.
windbreak: MA 380: Protected zone on the leeward side is 10 times the maximum design height (H) of the tallest row at age 20.
roughening: MA 609: Begin roughening on the windward (upwind) edge of the field; goal is to reduce wind erosion by 25 percent.
seeding: MA 327: Native grass rates are in lbs/ac PLS; if erosion is a concern, use an oat nurse crop not over 20 lbs/acre.
MA 327: Percent PLS = (% purity x % germination) / 100; bulk seed/ac = PLS/ac rate / (PLS % / 100).

coverPlant.text: MA 340: Winter rye optimal seeding is 15-Sep (zone 3b-5a), 20-Sep (5b), 25-Sep (6a-6b), 30-Sep (7a and above); standard/later 15-Oct to 31-Oct.
MA 340: Oats/barley/spring small grain optimal 15-Apr for spring/summer cover; fall optimal 1-Sep to 15-Sep by zone.

seedWin.text: MA 327: Native grasses are best seeded in late spring; dormant seeding is late fall after first hard frost of 27 °F, before snow.
